title: Validate the design-option count
responsibility: Returns the requested design count and rejects explicit counts outside the Plan rules.

inputs.name: designCount.request
inputs.description: The request whose optional designOptions count is checked: a RunRequest (mode 'plan' or 'change'), a ProjectRunRequest (mode always 'plan') or a ProjectTaskRequest (mode 'ask' or 'change'). An explicit designOptions is accepted only when mode is 'plan', where it must be an integer from 1 to 10; with designOptions omitted, any mode returns defaultDesignOptions (3).

examples.text: Plan five design options for the error message shown when a count is out of range.
Plan a function that validates the design-option count of a visual unit.
Keep the design-count error messages in step with the rule they enforce.

outputs.name: defaultDesignOptions
outputs.description: The exported constant defaultDesignOptions, declared as the literal 3. designCount returns this value whenever a request omits designOptions, for any mode.

outputs.name: designCount
outputs.description: The validated designOptions count of a Plan request, an integer from 1 to 10, or defaultDesignOptions (3) when designOptions is omitted in any mode. An explicit designOptions on a request whose mode is not 'plan' throws instead of returning a value.

errors.name: DesignOptionsOnChangeError
errors.description: Only a Plan may supply designOptions.

errors.name: InvalidDesignOptionsError
errors.description: A Plan's designOptions must be a whole number from 1 through 10.
